intro: Suriname has about 630,000 people from many backgrounds.

chapters.title: People
text: Hindustanis (of Indian descent), Maroons, Creoles, Javanese, Indigenous peoples and Chinese all live here. Dutch is official, and Sranan Tongo is the common language. Mosques and synagogues stand side by side in Paramaribo.

chapters.title: Paramaribo
text: Paramaribo's wooden old town is a World Heritage site.
